newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint closes steady vs dlr and basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint closes steady vs dlr and basket.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed little changed against the dollar in afternoon trade but firmer on the day on Thursday after tracking the movements of the dollar/mark cross throughout trading, dealers said.

The forint finished at 179.96/180.06, compared with 179.95/180.00 at midday and 180.20/25 at the opening. Large changes in the dollar/mark and dollar/yen resulted in the forint moving in a very large range of between 179.70 and 180.30 to the dollar.

Dealers said the international fluctuations scared most traders away from forint deals, leaving no domestic factors to prise the Hungarian unit away from close to the central bank's resistance level (bid).
"The big fluctuations, especially in the morning, made dealers scared about quoting," said Laszlo Egyed of WestLB Hungaria.
The forint floats against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark within the National Bank of Hungary's (NBH) 4.5 percent wide floating intervention range.
The NBH fixed the forint at 179.84 to one dollar on Thursday, compared with 179.74 on Wednesday.
